requirements.text: Personalised timetable management features: colour-coding for modules, hiding cancelled classes, and personal study blocks.
Automatic notifications for students whenever a new grade is posted for their modules.
Primary delivery method for grade notifications through email, with the possibility of in-app notifications as a secondary option.
Structured feedback submission process for students after the teaching period ends, covering aspects like content quality, delivery, and resources.
Ensure anonymity for students providing feedback.
Careful timing for when feedback is made available to module coordinators to avoid any impact on grading.
New features must integrate with the existing login process without requiring changes to how students currently access the portal.
Modifications to the student records database are not allowed, so enhancements must fit within the current framework.
Compliance with GDPR and the university's data policies is essential to avoid complications.
